title: Recipe browse and metadata editing
lead: Admin pages to list and view recipes and edit their larder metadata (R4).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** editing recipe content (done in git); ingredient review (separate slice).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The planner needs metadata (meal type, in rotation, favorite, servings, effort) that the files don't carry.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Metadata fields: meal type (dinner/breakfast/lunch/side/dessert), servings, in rotation (bool), favorite (bool; `recipe_meta.favorite`, R4), effort (quick/normal/project). Add or remove any?
2. Should a non-technical household member see recipe pages (read-only) from the Today view? (recommended: yes, with a "view recipe" link)

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, answered by the owner: (1) keep the metadata fields as listed (meal type dinner/breakfast/lunch/side/dessert, servings, in rotation, favorite, effort quick/normal/project); (2) a non-technical household member sees recipe pages read-only from the Today view, with a 'view recipe' link.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, spec-check answers: (1) a non-admin household member can open the recipe list and the single-recipe view page read-only; only the metadata form and the bulk control are admin-only (this differs from the spec check's recommendation of view-only, so the list route is open to members while the metadata form stays behind the admin guard); (2) the bulk 'mark in rotation' control submits the list's checkbox state: checked rows go in rotation and unchecked rows go out, touching only the rows on the page after filtering; the default stays 1 and there is no migration.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Recipe list with filters; recipe view rendering Markdown. Note: stdlib has no Markdown renderer, so render the known subset (headings, lists, bold, paragraphs) with escaping, or ask the owner before adding a dependency.
2. Metadata form with CSRF; store in `recipe_meta`.
3. Bulk "mark in rotation" checkboxes on the list for fast setup.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Web tests pass; after pairing, the owner can tag all imported recipes in a couple of minutes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Add recipe browse and metadata editing (S14).
